text:
Lina (Docs): opened a tiny docs PR to add a compact Optimize toolkit guidance: batching, prefix-KV caching, and quant-profile migration. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1104 (draft)
Omar K.: love this. two asks: 1) include a minimal Rust snippet (some teams use our Rust SDK for low-latency inference), 2) add a short migration map for legacy profile names.
Lina (Docs): adding both. keeping examples minimal and runnable. also will add a one-line decision rule for choosing q4_0 vs q8_0.
Ben (Runtime): please call out runtime default timeoutMs=10 in every snippet and mention that very small SLOs (<100ms) shouldn't use large batch windows. also note kv_prefetch increases GPU host memory usage depending on prefix size.
Lina (Docs): good catch. draft Rust snippet below: 
```
// Rust SDK (per-route) - batching + kv prefetch (pseudo)
use redwood_inference::Client;
let client = Client::new(std::env::var("REDWOOD_API_KEY").unwrap());
client.create_route("summarize", route_config!{
  model: "open-llama-13b-v2",
  batching: { max_tokens_per_batch: 1000, max_batch_size: 4, timeout_ms: 10 },
  kv_prefetch: { enabled: true, ttl_seconds: 300 }
});
```
Lina (Docs): migration mapping YAML (inline):
```
# quant-profiles.yml
compat-small: q4_0  # validate on your eval set; switch to q8_0 if quality drops
compat-large: q8_0  # prefer for instruction-heavy or safety-sensitive flows
```
bench-bot: lightweight benchmark (synth): q4_0 @ batch=4 median latency 34ms, q8_0 @ batch=4 median latency 50ms; cost delta ~ -27% for q4_0. gist: https://bench.redwood/q4q8-rust-sample
Omar K.: please add a one-line example of when NOT to enable kv_prefetch (very large unique prefixes with low reuse = avoid).
Lina (Docs): added a short "When not to use" bullet: "Avoid kv_prefetch when prefix reuse is low or when prefix KV entries are extremely large; prefer batching only or smaller TTLs."
linkcheck-bot: ci/docs-linkcheck reported a stale model alias; updated open-llama-13b -> open-llama-13b-v2 and fixed a broken SDK link.
Ben (Runtime): LGTM aside from a tiny wording tweak (use imperative voice). Lina updated phrasing. Tagging @Omar K. for final review.
Omar K.: minor nit: change max_batch_size to 6 in Rust snippet to reflect common defaults. updated. Approving once CI is green.
Lina (Docs): thanks everyone 389: will merge after CI passes and add anchor #optkit-mini so release notes can link to the microguide.
